🚀 We're Hiring: Student Success Associate (Remote)

Do you love helping people cross the finish line? We're looking for a Student Success Associate to join our Placement team and turn every eligible student's learning journey into a real job offer.

📍 Location: Remote 
🗓️ Work Week: 5 days (Weekly offs: Saturday & Monday) 
💼 Preferred Background: Pre-Sales experience

What you'll own: 
🎯 Build and nurture a pipeline of hiring partners actively hiring in our students' domains 
🎯 Match students to roles based on skill level, specialization, and career goals 🎯 Track placement metrics — time-to-placement, offer acceptance, role relevance, starting comp 
🎯 Proactively reach out to job-ready students who've stalled — resume gaps, low application activity, interview anxiety 
🎯 Set milestones, run check-ins, and keep students accountable to their placement timeline 
🎯 Spot at-risk students early and intervene before they disengage 
🎯 Document and share student success stories to motivate peers and inspire prospective learners

What we're looking for: 
✅ Strong communication and relationship-building skills — you'll be talking to students and hiring partners daily 
✅ A background in pre-sales, counselling, or a similar target-driven, people-facing role (preferred) 
✅ Comfort with follow-ups, outreach, and holding people accountable — kindly but consistently 
✅ Genuine investment in outcomes, not just activity 
✅ Organized and data-minded — you'll track and report on placement metrics regularly

If you get energy from watching someone land their first job — and you're not afraid to chase down the follow-through to make it happen — we'd love to hear from you.

📩 Interested? Apply here: https://lnkd.in/gPjm3jUr Or drop a comment / tag someone who'd be perfect for this.
